summary: HEEBA/هيبة PUBG rewards app — full backend + frontend testing completed. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests passed (auth, wheel, store, rewards, referrals, notifications, channels, admin CRUD, admin gating). Frontend: verified login → subscribe → home → wheel → store → rewards → referrals → admin dashboard → admin prizes flows on 390x844 mobile viewport. Admin login (admin@heeba.app / Heeba@Admin2026) works, session persists, auth gate redirects unsubscribed users to /subscribe. Seeded data verified: 7 prizes, 7 products, 3 channels, 5 creators. Admin dashboard shows 7 tiles; admin/prizes shows all 7 seeded prizes with edit/delete. Minor React Native web console warnings observed (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: React warning: 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`'. Emitted while rendering the animated wheel on web. Should use camelCase transformOrigin in style or Animated.View. Reference: /app/frontend/app/wheel.tsx (wheel rotation transform).

Deprecation warnings from React Native Web: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow"' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Emitted from multiple screens (login, wheel, home, admin). Non-fatal but should be migrated.

action_items: In /app/frontend/app/wheel.tsx replace any 'transform-origin' style key with camelCase 'transformOrigin' to silence the React DOM warning on web.
Migrate deprecated textShadow*/shadow* style props to the new unified 'textShadow'/'boxShadow' props across screens (login, home, wheel, admin).

Optional UX: on Subscribe screen the 'تحقق من الاشتراك' (verify) button is disabled until every channel row has been tapped once — consider showing a helper tooltip so users know they must open each channel first.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~780 lines; still manageable but nearing the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting routers per resource (auth, wheel, store, admin) into separate modules as the app grows.
clean() removes _id but several endpoints return raw list results directly from Motor with projection {'_id': 0} — good practice already followed consistently.
Wheel spin logic correctly uses weighted random selection and enforces 24h cooldown with 429; item-type prizes create a pending win for admin review.
Admin token verification via JWT payload.type == 'admin' is sound; non-admin session tokens return 403 on /api/admin/*.
seed_data_creation: Seeded data verified via startup routine: 7 prizes, 7 products, 3 channels, 5 creators, wheel config. Admin bootstrap user (admin@heeba.app) auto-created. During testing, admin's last_spin_at + subscribed_channels were reset in Mongo twice to re-exercise wheel-spin-cooldown and subscribe-screen redirect flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_heeba_backend.py — run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_heeba_backend.py -v. Some tests (wheel-spin) will SKIP if admin already spun in last 24h; reset via: mongosh heeba_pubg --eval 'db.users.updateOne({email:"admin@heeba.app"},{$unset:{last_spin_at:""}})'. Frontend admin login flow: click admin-login-btn -> fill admin-email-input/admin-password-input -> click admin-submit-btn. Auth gate in _layout.tsx redirects to /subscribe if user.subscribed_channels is empty, else to /(tabs)/home.
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. Two console warnings only: (1) 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' — root cause: a style prop uses the CSS kebab-case 'transform-origin' where React Native Web expects camelCase 'transformOrigin'. Fix: rename the key in the wheel screen's style object. (2) textShadow*/shadow* deprecation — root cause: React Native ≥0.74 unified these into single shorthand props; upgrade the individual textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius/etc keys into the new unified format.
